name: waypoints
description: A route for /goal and any multi-step work, built from Claude's own task plan: the plan drawn as a line of nodes and legs above the prompt, an ETA at the goal's own pace, a pane that opens by itself with the whole task trail, and every chat's goal in /waypoints. Follows Agent-Pulse's palette and animation. Claude is asked to plan by the mod itself. Fork of Nate Herk's goal-meter 1.0.0.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: follow uses Agent-Pulse's palette (ember when it is not installed); ember is Claude's warm orange range, claude follows your theme, neon is bioluminescent sea colors, mono keeps color for what needs you

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: follow uses Agent-Pulse's level (subtle when it is not installed); off keeps everything still, subtle pulses the running task, full also breathes the node and sweeps the route when the plan finishes

pane.title: Pane
pane.description: auto opens the Waypoints pane when a plan starts (it never takes the keys from the prompt, and waits on a narrow window); off opens it only when you ask with /waypoints or g

linger.title: Finished plan stays
linger.description: How long the band and the footer's done label stay after a plan finishes or is stopped; an auto-opened pane closes then too (a pane you opened yourself stays)

managed.title: Managed plan
managed.description: For Team and Enterprise plans, whose built-in guard skips some of waypoints' hooks and posts a "hook was skipped" line for each. auto switches this to on by itself the first time it sees that; on leaves those hooks out (no notices), asks Claude to plan beside your first prompt and reads the goal check when each turn ends, with no row for background work; off never switches

herdr.title: Herdr status
herdr.description: For Claude Code in a Herdr terminal on Windows: on makes Herdr show Needs you when a turn ends with a plan task still open (Herdr otherwise says done). Needs Windows PowerShell 5 or PowerShell 7 and herdr-core's hc; Waypoints checks both when a session starts. Off by default
